test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - GA (Held On 9 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: With reference to the Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme, which of the following statements is INCORRECT?

options.text: The scheme was launched in January 2015.
The scheme account can be opened with a minimum of Rs. 100.
The scheme was launched as a part of the 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' campaign.
The account can be opened in any post office or authorised branches of commercial banks

solution:
The correct answer is **__t____he scheme account can be opened with a minimum of Rs. 100__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **Sukanya Samriddhi Account **can be** opened any time** after the** birth of a girl till she turns 10, **with a** minimum deposit of Rs 250 (Earlier it was Rs 1,000). ****Hence, the second statement** is** incorrect.**
 
• In subsequent years, a minimum of** Rs 250 and a maximum of Rs 1.5 lakh **can be deposited during the ongoing financial year.
 
• The **scheme encourages** parents to build a **fund for education **and **marriage for their girl child.**
 
• Contribution to this account qualifies for **tax deduction under Section 80C.**
 
• The scheme was launched on **22** **January 2015 **in **Panipat, Haryana.**
 
• The scheme was launched by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi 
 
• The scheme was launched as a part of the** 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' campaign.**
 
• The account can be **opened **in **any post office** or **authorized branches** of **commercial banks.**
